import_atomic_radii_dict: import the ATOMIC_RADII dictionary to look up atomic radii in picometers by atomic number
lookup_atomic_radius_by_number: look up the atomic radius in picometers for a given element using its atomic number as a key
check_nan_for_unavailable_radii: check if an atomic radius value is NaN to determine if the parameter is unavailable for that element
iterate_atomic_radii: iterate over the ATOMIC_RADII dictionary to process all atomic numbers and their corresponding radii values
filter_valid_atomic_radii: filter the ATOMIC_RADII dictionary to extract only elements with valid non-NaN atomic radius values
